sourceProvenance.provenanceRule: Source identifiers are metadata only. Semantic function keys and Mathematica-facing names describe thermodynamic meaning rather than reproducing CALPHAD or SGTE acronyms.
sourceProvenance.provisionalUseRestriction: This canonical library entry remains provisional and is suitable for reader development. It must not be treated as an authoritative unary dataset until every coefficient, breakpoint, endpoint convention, and validity limit has been checked directly against the primary Dinsdale source.

verification.reproducibilityRule: Computed verification values are consequences of the encoded functions and must be reproducible without using the verification metadata as model input.

computedValue.method: numerical root of equal Gibbs energies
computedValue.reproducibility: Evaluate the two named functions from their encoded temperature segments and solve the stated equality within their common validity range.
computedValue.note: This is a metastable phase crossing, not a stable-envelope transition.

sourceValue.note: The discussion identifies 923 K as the Mg melting/equality boundary and reports SGTE/COST corroboration; direct verification against the Dinsdale Mg table is pending.

computedValue.method: numerical root of equal Gibbs energies
computedValue.reproducibility: Evaluate the two named functions from their encoded temperature segments and solve the stated equality within their common validity range.
computedValue.note: This is a stable-envelope transition. Rounded coefficients yield roots at 922.9999718767 K and 923.0001083905 K rather than one exact continuous crossing; 923.0 K is the physically meaningful value to the precision of the source extraction.
